reason: A local stdio MCP server primarily providing text-only agents with external image understanding, with experimental image generation and editing capabilities.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 stdio MCP 服务器调用外部视觉服务，为文本智能体提供图像理解，并支持实验性的图像生成与编辑。
summaries.en: A local stdio MCP server that gives text-only agents external image understanding, with experimental image generation and editing capabilities.

capabilities: Understands images, screenshots, documents, charts, diagrams, and visible text through an external vision API
Sends user-provided images to the configured Agnes API for inference
Generates and edits images experimentally through the external provider
Writes generated or downloaded image results to a local output directory
Uses an API key for direct BYOK authentication
